scope: Internal synthetic relationships, not reference plots or approved artwork

examples.behavior: Candidates attempt the same task, failed ones exit and the remaining one receives the result. Several beats continue the same elimination rule.
Twenty receipts arrive, compress a single scale and lower its tray. Many moving papers form one cost group; accumulation is the meaning.
One document feeds under a lens, marks are revealed, repairs align the same marks, then the page exits. Several changing states under one inspection rule.
A folded sample leaves an inspection set and enters a separate comparison set. Its nick remains visible; the lens and table do not travel with it.
A visibly interrupted route reconnects and carries its token through. No character role is required.
Three unrelated propositions use the same central rectangular slab, tiny left Bot and wide framing without justification. A background recolor does not fix the staging.
